statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
There is concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or tachy-brady syndrome
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
The diagnoses addressed are R55 and I48.91
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
